verdict.rationale: LangGraph's core model is explicit graphs (State, Nodes, Edges) supporting loops, branching, and parallel execution via its Pregel/BSP engine, corroborated by both docs and independent community analysis confirming genuine cycles/parallelism without data races. Multi-agent composition patterns and embedding nodes as subgraphs are documented, giving strong first-party and hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: no first-party benchmark or deep example specifically demonstrating parallel branch fan-out/fan-in beyond general claims.
